title: Adding and Subtracting Fractions with Unlike Denominators
seo_title: Grade 5 Adding and Subtracting Fractions with Unlike Denominators (TEKS 5.3H, STAAR)
standard_text: 5.3H represent and solve addition and subtraction of fractions with unequal denominators referring to the same whole using objects and pictorial models and properties of operations; 5.3K add and subtract positive rational numbers fluently
meta_desc: Free Grade 5 fraction worksheets for Texas TEKS 5.3H and 5.3K: common denominators, add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers with unlike denominators, and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Rename with a common denominator, then add or subtract the numerators.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Fractions can be added or subtracted only when the pieces are the same size. Rename both fractions with a common denominator.
  • Then add or subtract the numerators and keep the denominator: 1/3 + 1/4 = 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12.
  • For mixed numbers, rename the fractions, then add or subtract wholes and fractions. Regroup when needed and simplify.
  • Estimate with 0, 1/2 and 1 to check.

Examples

Example

2/3 + 1/4

Common denominator 12

8/12 + 3/12

Answer: 11/12

Example

3 1/4 − 1 2/3

3 3/12 − 1 8/12

Regroup: 2 15/12 − 1 8/12

Answer: 1 7/12

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding the denominators: 1/3 + 1/4 = 2/7Rename with a common denominator first.
Renaming only one fractionBoth fractions must have the same denominator.
Forgetting to regroup a wholeIf the first fraction is smaller, rename 1 whole.

faq.a: Represent and solve addition and subtraction of fractions with unequal denominators referring to the same whole using objects, pictorial models and properties of operations.
Add and subtract positive rational numbers fluently.

faq.q: How do you find a common denominator?
faq.a: Find a common multiple of both denominators, often the least common multiple: for 4 and 6, use 12.
Answers are usually written in simplest form, such as 6/8 = 3/4.

items.q: The green part is 13 and the yellow part is 14. The dashed lines cut both bars into twelfths. Which shows both fractions in twelfths?
c: 112 and 112
1012 and 912
312 and 412
412 and 312
items.e: Count the small parts in each shaded piece. 3 × 4 = 12, so multiply the top and bottom of 13 by 4: 412. 4 × 3 = 12, so multiply the top and bottom of 14 by 3: 312. The answer is 412 and 312.

210 and 1010

48 and 38

items.q: What is the least common denominator of 34 and 16?
items.e: Multiples of 6: 6, 12. Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12. The first number in both lists is 12. 4 × 6 = 24 is also a common denominator, but it is not the least.

items.q: What is the least common denominator of 16 and 38?
items.e: Multiples of 8: 8, 16, 24. Multiples of 6: 6, 12, 18, 24. The first number in both lists is 24. 6 × 8 = 48 is also a common denominator, but it is not the least.

items.q: What is the least common denominator of 23 and 15?
items.e: Multiples of 5: 5, 10, 15. Multiples of 3: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15. The first number in both lists is 15.

items.q: What is the least common denominator of 14 and 310?
items.e: Multiples of 10: 10, 20. Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. The first number in both lists is 20. 4 × 10 = 40 is also a common denominator, but it is not the least.

items.q: What is the least common denominator of 58 and 712?
items.e: Multiples of 12: 12, 24. Multiples of 8: 8, 16, 24. The first number in both lists is 24. 8 × 12 = 96 is also a common denominator, but it is not the least.

items.q: Rewrite 23 and 34 with the denominator 12.
c: 212 and 312
812 and 912
612 and 1212
1112 and 1112
items.e: 3 × 4 = 12, so multiply the top and bottom of 23 by 4: 812. 4 × 3 = 12, so multiply the top and bottom of 34 by 3: 912. The answer is 812 and 912.

c: 110 and 310
210 and 1510
910 and 810
510 and 610
items.e: 2 × 5 = 10, so multiply the top and bottom of 12 by 5: 510. 5 × 2 = 10, so multiply the top and bottom of 35 by 2: 610. The answer is 510 and 610.

924 and 424
1224 and 324
324 and 124
items.e: 8 × 3 = 24, so multiply the top and bottom of 38 by 3: 924. 6 × 4 = 24, so multiply the top and bottom of 16 by 4: 424. The answer is 924 and 424.

items.q: Rewrite 25 and 13 with the denominator 15.
c: 1215 and 1315
1015 and 315
215 and 115
615 and 515
items.e: 5 × 3 = 15, so multiply the top and bottom of 25 by 3: 615. 3 × 5 = 15, so multiply the top and bottom of 13 by 5: 515. The answer is 615 and 515.

items.q: Rewrite 14 and 56 with the denominator 24.
c: 2124 and 2324
424 and 3024
124 and 524
624 and 2024
items.e: 4 × 6 = 24, so multiply the top and bottom of 14 by 6: 624. 6 × 4 = 24, so multiply the top and bottom of 56 by 4: 2024. The answer is 624 and 2024. (12 also works, but any common denominator gives the right answer.)

items.e: 4 × 5 = 20, so multiply the top by 5 too: 3 × 5 = 15. So 34 = 1520.

items.q: Which pair of fractions can both be written as twelfths?
c: 38 and 13
29 and 14
14 and 56
15 and 12
items.e: 12 must be a multiple of both denominators. 4 × 3 = 12 and 6 × 2 = 12, so 14 and 56 works. In the other pairs, 12 is not a multiple of one of the denominators.

items.q: Which pair of fractions can both be written as tenths?
c: 12 and 35
23 and 12
38 and 15
14 and 25
items.e: 10 must be a multiple of both denominators. 2 × 5 = 10 and 5 × 2 = 10, so 12 and 35 works. In the other pairs, 10 is not a multiple of one of the denominators.

items.q:
The bar is cut into sixths. Green shows 12 and yellow shows 13. What is 12 + 13?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 2 and 3 is 6. Rewrite: 12 = 36 and 13 = 26. Add the numerators: 36 + 26 = 56. The answer is 56.

Write the answer in simplest form.

Write the answer as a mixed number in simplest form.

items.q: Isabella wrote 13 + 14 = 27. What mistake did she make?
c: She added the tops and the bottoms
items.e: Thirds and fourths are different sizes, so you cannot just add the tops and bottoms. Rewrite them as twelfths: 412 + 312 = 712. 27 is even less than 13, so it cannot be the sum.

items.q: 12 + ? = 56
items.e: Think: 56 − 12. Rewrite 12 = 36. Then 56 − 36 = 26 = 13. Check: 12 + 13 = 36 + 26 = 56. The answer is 13.

items.q:
The number line is cut into twelfths. The jump shows 56 − 14. Where does it end?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The jump starts at 56 = 1012 and goes back 14 = 312, 3 spaces. The least common denominator of 6 and 4 is 12. Rewrite: 56 = 1012 and 14 = 312. Subtract the numerators: 1012 − 312 = 712. The answer is 712.

items.q: ? − 13 = 12
items.e: Think: 12 + 13. Rewrite 12 = 36 and 13 = 26. Then 36 + 26 = 56. Check: 56 − 13 = 56 − 26 = 36. The answer is 56.

items.q: 34 − ? = 16
items.e: Think: 34 − 16. Rewrite 34 = 912 and 16 = 212. Then 912 − 212 = 712. Check: 34 − 712 = 912 − 712 = 212. The answer is 712.

items.q: Josiah wrote 56 − 14 = 42. What mistake did he make?
items.e: Sixths and fourths are different sizes. Josiah subtracted the tops and the bottoms. Use twelfths: 1012 − 312 = 712. Also, 42 = 2, which is more than 56, so it cannot be right.

items.q:
How much more is 78 than 12?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: “How much more” means subtract. 8 is a multiple of 2, so use 8 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 12 = 48. Subtract the numerators: 78 − 48 = 38. The answer is 38.

items.q:
How much more is 23 than 14?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: “How much more” means subtract. The least common denominator of 3 and 4 is 12. Rewrite: 23 = 812 and 14 = 312. Subtract the numerators: 812 − 312 = 512. The answer is 512.

items.q:

Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: “How much more” means subtract. 10 is a multiple of 5, so use 10 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 35 = 610. Subtract the numerators: 910 − 610 = 310. The answer is 310.

items.q:
2 13 + 1 14 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 3 and 4 is 12. Rewrite: 2 13 = 2 412 and 1 14 = 1 312. Add the fractions: 412 + 312 = 712. Add the whole numbers: 2 + 1 = 3. The answer is 3 712.

items.q:
1 12 + 2 15 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 2 and 5 is 10. Rewrite: 1 12 = 1 510 and 2 15 = 2 210. Add the fractions: 510 + 210 = 710. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 2 = 3. The answer is 3 710.

items.q:
2 38 + 4 14 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 4 14 = 4 28. Add the fractions: 38 + 28 = 58. Add the whole numbers: 2 + 4 = 6. The answer is 6 58.

items.q:
1 16 + 2 34 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 6 and 4 is 12. Rewrite: 1 16 = 1 212 and 2 34 = 2 912. Add the fractions: 212 + 912 = 1112. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 2 = 3. The answer is 3 1112.

items.q:
1 23 + 2 34 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 3 and 4 is 12. Rewrite: 1 23 = 1 812 and 2 34 = 2 912. Add the fractions: 812 + 912 = 1712. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 2 = 3. 1712 is more than 1: 1712 = 1 512. 3 + 1 512 = 4 512. The answer is 4 512.

items.q:
2 56 + 1 12 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 6 is a multiple of 2, so use 6 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 1 12 = 1 36. Add the fractions: 56 + 36 = 86. Add the whole numbers: 2 + 1 = 3. 86 is more than 1: 86 = 1 26. 3 + 1 26 = 4 26. Simplify: divide the top and bottom of 26 by 2 to get 13. The answer is 4 13.

items.q:
3 45 + 1 12 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 5 and 2 is 10. Rewrite: 3 45 = 3 810 and 1 12 = 1 510. Add the fractions: 810 + 510 = 1310. Add the whole numbers: 3 + 1 = 4. 1310 is more than 1: 1310 = 1 310. 4 + 1 310 = 5 310. The answer is 5 310.

items.q:
1 78 + 2 14 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 2 14 = 2 28. Add the fractions: 78 + 28 = 98. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 2 = 3. 98 is more than 1: 98 = 1 18. 3 + 1 18 = 4 18. The answer is 4 18.

items.q:
2 34 + 3 56 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 4 and 6 is 12. Rewrite: 2 34 = 2 912 and 3 56 = 3 1012. Add the fractions: 912 + 1012 = 1912. Add the whole numbers: 2 + 3 = 5. 1912 is more than 1: 1912 = 1 712. 5 + 1 712 = 6 712. The answer is 6 712.

items.q:
3 34 − 1 13 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 4 and 3 is 12. Rewrite: 3 34 = 3 912 and 1 13 = 1 412. Subtract the fractions: 912 − 412 = 512. Subtract the whole numbers: 3 − 1 = 2. The answer is 2 512.

items.q:
5 56 − 2 12 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 6 is a multiple of 2, so use 6 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 2 12 = 2 36. Subtract the fractions: 56 − 36 = 26. Subtract the whole numbers: 5 − 2 = 3. Simplify: divide the top and bottom of 26 by 2 to get 13. The answer is 3 13.

items.q:
4 710 − 1 25 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 10 is a multiple of 5, so use 10 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 1 25 = 1 410. Subtract the fractions: 710 − 410 = 310. Subtract the whole numbers: 4 − 1 = 3. The answer is 3 310.

items.q:
6 23 − 4 16 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 6 is a multiple of 3, so use 6 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 6 23 = 6 46. Subtract the fractions: 46 − 16 = 36. Subtract the whole numbers: 6 − 4 = 2. Simplify: divide the top and bottom of 36 by 3 to get 12. The answer is 2 12.

items.q:
3 14 − 1 23 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 4 and 3 is 12. Rewrite: 3 14 = 3 312 and 1 23 = 1 812. 312 is less than 812, so rename 1 whole: 3 312 = 2 1512. Subtract the fractions: 1512 − 812 = 712. Subtract the whole numbers: 2 − 1 = 1. The answer is 1 712.

items.q:
4 13 − 2 12 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 3 and 2 is 6. Rewrite: 4 13 = 4 26 and 2 12 = 2 36. 26 is less than 36, so rename 1 whole: 4 26 = 3 86. Subtract the fractions: 86 − 36 = 56. Subtract the whole numbers: 3 − 2 = 1. The answer is 1 56.

items.q:
5 16 − 2 34 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 6 and 4 is 12. Rewrite: 5 16 = 5 212 and 2 34 = 2 912. 212 is less than 912, so rename 1 whole: 5 212 = 4 1412. Subtract the fractions: 1412 − 912 = 512. Subtract the whole numbers: 4 − 2 = 2. The answer is 2 512.

items.q:
6 25 − 3 12 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 5 and 2 is 10. Rewrite: 6 25 = 6 410 and 3 12 = 3 510. 410 is less than 510, so rename 1 whole: 6 410 = 5 1410. Subtract the fractions: 1410 − 510 = 910. Subtract the whole numbers: 5 − 3 = 2. The answer is 2 910.

items.q:
7 18 − 4 34 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 4 34 = 4 68. 18 is less than 68, so rename 1 whole: 7 18 = 6 98. Subtract the fractions: 98 − 68 = 38. Subtract the whole numbers: 6 − 4 = 2. The answer is 2 38.

items.q:
5 12 − 2 56 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 6 is a multiple of 2, so use 6 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 5 12 = 5 36. 36 is less than 56, so rename 1 whole: 5 36 = 4 96. Subtract the fractions: 96 − 56 = 46. Subtract the whole numbers: 4 − 2 = 2. Simplify: divide the top and bottom of 46 by 2 to get 23. The answer is 2 23.

items.q: Without finding the exact sum, is 25 + 12 more than 1 or less than 1?
items.e: Use the benchmark 12. 12 + 12 = 1, and 25 is less than 12, so the sum is less than 1. (The exact sum is 910.)

items.q:
Mia hiked 12 mile to the lake and then 38 mile along the shore. How far did she hike in all?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 2, so use 8 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 12 = 48. Add the numerators: 48 + 38 = 78. The answer is 78 mile.

items.q:
A muffin recipe uses 23 cup of flour and 14 cup of sugar. How many cups of flour and sugar is that in all?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 3 and 4 is 12. Rewrite: 23 = 812 and 14 = 312. Add the numerators: 812 + 312 = 1112. The answer is 1112 cup.

items.q: Without finding the exact sum, is 58 + 47 more than 1 or less than 1?
items.e: 58 is more than 12, and 47 is more than 12. Two numbers that are each more than 12 add up to more than 1. (The exact sum is 1 1156.)

items.q:
Carlos had 34 yard of ribbon. He used 13 yard to wrap a gift. How much ribbon is left?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 4 and 3 is 12. Rewrite: 34 = 912 and 13 = 412. Subtract the numerators: 912 − 412 = 512. The answer is 512 yard.

items.q:
It rained 1 12 inches on Monday and 34 inch on Tuesday. How much rain fell on the two days in all?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 4 is a multiple of 2, so use 4 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 1 12 = 1 24. Add the fractions: 24 + 34 = 54. The whole number is 1. 54 is more than 1: 54 = 1 14. 1 + 1 14 = 2 14. The answer is 2 14 inches.

items.q: Which benchmark is 37 + 18 closest to?
items.e: 37 is close to 12, and 18 is close to 0. So 37 + 18 is about 12 + 0 = 12. (The exact sum is 3156.)

items.q:
Aaliyah painted 13 of a wall in the morning and 12 of it after lunch. What fraction of the wall is left to paint?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: First add what she painted. Rewrite 13 = 26 and 12 = 36: 26 + 36 = 56. The whole wall is 66. Left: 66 − 56 = 16.

items.q:
A pitcher holds 2 12 liters of lemonade. The class drinks 1 23 liters. How much lemonade is left?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 2 and 3 is 6. Rewrite: 2 12 = 2 36 and 1 23 = 1 46. 36 is less than 46, so rename 1 whole: 2 36 = 1 96. Subtract the fractions: 96 − 46 = 56. Subtract the whole numbers: 1 − 1 = 0. The answer is 56 liter.

items.q:
Ethan practiced the piano for 34 hour on Saturday and 23 hour on Sunday. How long did he practice in all?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 4 and 3 is 12. Rewrite: 34 = 912 and 23 = 812. Add the numerators: 912 + 812 = 1712. 1712 is more than 1: 1712 = 1 512. The answer is 1 512 hours.

items.q:
A board is 6 14 feet long. Josiah cuts off a piece that is 2 12 feet long. How long is the part that is left?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 4 is a multiple of 2, so use 4 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 2 12 = 2 24. 14 is less than 24, so rename 1 whole: 6 14 = 5 54. Subtract the fractions: 54 − 24 = 34. Subtract the whole numbers: 5 − 2 = 3. The answer is 3 34 feet.

items.q: About how much is 1112 + 78?
items.e: 1112 and 78 are each close to 1. So the sum is about 1 + 1 = 2. (The exact sum is 1 1924.)

items.q:
Sofia ran 2 35 miles. Camila ran 1 34 miles. How much farther did Sofia run than Camila?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: “How much farther” means subtract. The least common denominator of 5 and 4 is 20. Rewrite: 2 35 = 2 1220 and 1 34 = 1 1520. 1220 is less than 1520, so rename 1 whole: 2 1220 = 1 3220. Subtract the fractions: 3220 − 1520 = 1720. Subtract the whole numbers: 1 − 1 = 0. The answer is 1720 mile.

items.q:
Nevaeh's water bottle holds 45 liter of water. She drinks 12 liter during soccer practice. How much water is left?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 5 and 2 is 10. Rewrite: 45 = 810 and 12 = 510. Subtract the numerators: 810 − 510 = 310. The answer is 310 liter.

items.q:
A garden is planted with tomatoes in 14 of it and beans in 25 of it. The rest is for flowers. What fraction of the garden is for flowers?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: First add the parts that are used. Rewrite 14 = 520 and 25 = 820: 520 + 820 = 1320. The whole garden is 2020. Left for flowers: 2020 − 1320 = 720.

items.q: About how much is 5 16 − 2 78?
items.e: 5 16 is close to 5, and 2 78 is close to 3. So the difference is about 5 − 3 = 2. (The exact difference is 2 724.)

items.q:
Ava makes trail mix with 38 pound of peanuts and 13 pound of raisins. How much trail mix does she make?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 8 and 3 is 24. Rewrite: 38 = 924 and 13 = 824. Add the numerators: 924 + 824 = 1724. The answer is 1724 pound.

items.q: Grace has 1 cup of milk. She needs 12 cup for pancakes and 38 cup for muffins. Does she have enough milk?
c: No. The sum is more than 1
No. 38 is more than 12
Yes. The sum is less than 1
items.e: 38 is less than 12, so 12 + 38 is less than 12 + 12 = 1. Yes, 1 cup is enough. (She needs 78 cup.)

items.q:
Liam wants to read for 2 hours this weekend. He read for 1 14 hours on Saturday and 13 hour on Sunday. How much longer does he need to read?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: First add the time he read. Rewrite 1 14 = 1 312 and 13 = 412: 1 312 + 412 = 1 712. Then subtract from 2. Rename 2 = 1 1212. 1 1212 − 1 712 = 512 hour.
